name: patches
summary: Rewrite stored patches whose block settings changed shape (no load-time conversion; SPEC-PATCH-FORMAT-V2). CHG-0040: Random Note's key + scale + octaves become 12 weights + a semitone range; Chord's one chord becomes the same chord on all 12 notes, Smooth off. Works on patch files (and golden fixtures) or every revision in an env's D1, after exporting a backup.
outputs: JSON on stdout: what changed (files, or revisions with block counts) and the backup path; patch files rewritten in place; .cache/backups/<env>-<time>.sql
